subject: Next steps + success metrics for Cordero Health trial
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@corderohealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ethan.cole@corderohealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo

Thanks for the demo earlier — that was helpful. A couple quick clarifying Qs from our side before we punt to procurement:

- Latency: you mentioned p95 under load of ~120ms for single-turn text gen. Can you confirm for sequences up to 1k tokens? Our typical transcript length is 600-900 tokens.
- Cost: rough per-token estimate for the hosted path versus a dedicated pool for 5M tokens/mo.
- Data handling: confirmation that customer data in hosted mode is not used for training and retention window.

We'd like a short POC plan (2–4 weeks) with clear owner responsibilities and success gates so procurement can evaluate risk. Can you send a one-page plan that highlights KPIs and who owns what?

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of AI Integrations
Cordero Health

---
Attachment: Cordero-demo-notes.txt (text)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@corderohealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo

Samira — thanks for the quick recap and great questions. High level answers inline, and below I attached a short POC plan that maps success gates to owners. Happy to sync if you want to walk through it.

- Latency: for sequences up to 1,024 tokens we observe p95 140–180ms on our hosted M-variant when serving single-concurrent requests; under continuous concurrency (50 req/s), p95 rises to ~320ms unless we move to a dedicated pool with batching optimizations. We'll include sample traces in the plan.
- Cost: hosted estimate ~ $0.0009 per token (generation+context) at current published rates; dedicated pool pricing for your expected 5M tokens/month would bring per-token below $0.00045 after a reserved capacity commit — I'll include a modeled spreadsheet.
- Data handling: hosted API: we offer a contractual data non-use clause (no training), configurable retention windows, and encrypted audit logs. Private/Self-host options available if you need on-prem.

Attached: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (POC plan, 1 page) and cordero-cost-estimate.xlsx (cost model).

POC summary (2-week sprint option) — success gates we propose:
1) Functional: 95% of sampled responses meet agreed quality threshold (ROC AUC >= 0.82 on the labeled test set) — Owner: Cordero (Samira / Ethan) + Redwood (Grace)
2) Performance: p95 inference latency <= 350ms for representative sessions (600–900 tokens) under test workload — Owner: Redwood (Jordan)
3) Throughput: system sustains 40 concurrent active sessions with 20 req/s burst for at least 30 minutes — Owner: Redwood (Jordan)
4) Cost: per-token cost within modeled estimate (within 15% variance) — Owner: Redwood (Karthik)
5) Security & compliance: evidence of audit logs, retention window config, and SOC2 attestation provided — Owner: Redwood (Monica)

Next steps (suggested):
- You review attached plan and cost sheet by end of week (Fri 2/12).
- We provision a sandbox dedicated pool (2 GPUs) and share test creds.
- Kickoff call Monday 2/15 to set up dataset handoff and test harness.

If these gates look good I'll update the doc to a 4-week path with extended monitoring if you prefer.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (application/pdf), cordero-cost-estimate.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Samira Khan <samira@corderohealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ethan.cole@corderohealth.com, procurement@corderohealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + success metrics for Cordero Health trial

Thanks Karthik — this is very helpful and closer to what procurement needs. Two follow-ups from our security team:

1) Can Redwood confirm the default retention window for hosted logs and whether it can be reduced to 30 days for our account?
2) We need to see the SOC2 report and a sample audit log export.

On the success gates: Procurement prefers a 4-week PoC so they can evaluate both performance under load and integration completeness. Proposed change: keep the same gates but extend the verification window to 2x the burst period (i.e., 1 hour). Will that be an issue for resource allocation?

Also looping Ethan — he will own data handoff and provide the labeled test set.

Best,
Samira

---
Attachment: security-questions.pdf (text)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@corderohealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Next steps + success metrics for Cordero Health trial

Samira — thanks, and appreciate the clarity from procurement. Quick answers & adjusted plan below.

- Retention: default hosted audit/log retention is 90 days; we can contractually reduce to 30 days for your account and will document the change in the PoC SoW. Owner: Monica to confirm and produce the sample export by EOD Mon 2/15.
- SOC2: Monica will attach the SOC2 report and a redacted audit log export.
- 4-week PoC: confirm we can support a 4-week cadence. We'll update the plan: verification windows extended to 1 hour and include an ops-runbook for ramp/burst testing. Resource ask: Jordan will allocate the dedicated pool for the trial window; Grace will lead response-quality labeling and evaluation automation.

Updated timeline (proposed):
- Mon 2/15: Kickoff, dataset handoff (Ethan), test creds shared
- Tue 2/16–Wed 2/24: Integration + baseline runs (first 3 days smoke, then ramp)
- Thu 2/25–Fri 2/26: Burst/resilience testing (1 hour sustained bursts)
- Mon 2/29: Final readout & scorecard delivered to procurement

Action items (owners):
- Monica: SOC2 + audit log sample; retention change confirmation (due Mon 2/15)
- Jordan: sandbox provisioning + ops-runbook (due Tue 2/16)
- Grace: evaluation rubric and sample labeling script (due Tue 2/16)
- Ethan (Cordero): dataset and test cases (due Mon 2/15)
- Karthik: finalize SoW and pricing addendum (due Wed 2/17)

I'll turn this into a short SoW and send for signature once we have procurement's OK. Anything missing from your side?

Thanks — looking forward to running this.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
